title: IELTS Intensive Academy - Automated Infrastructure & Linux Hardening
description: ⚙️ Infrastructure Automation: Built Bash Scripts to automate entire server provisioning process: Install LAMP Stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP), configure VirtualHost and system permissions in <5 minutes.
🔐 Security Hardening: Established OS and Web Server level security: Auto SSL configuration (Certbot), optimized Security Headers (X-Frame, X-XSS), and strict permissions for Webroot/Storage.
📈 Performance Tuning: Optimized Apache configuration (Gzip, Caching headers for Assets), fine-tuned MySQL Buffer Pool enabling website to handle stable load on EC2 t3.medium instance.

content.title: Project Information
content.description: 🏢 Project Name: IELTS Intensive Academy - Automated Infrastructure & Linux Hardening
list: Tech Stack: AWS EC2 (Ubuntu), Bash Scripting, LAMP Stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP), Let's Encrypt (Certbot), Git

content.title: 1. The Challenge
content.description: The client needed to deploy an online course sales website system (PHP/MySQL) on AWS. The requirements were:
list: Cost Optimization: Must run stably on a small instance (t3.medium) to save budget.
Rapid Deployment: The old manual server setup process took 2-3 hours and frequently encountered permission errors (Permission denied) when the application wrote log/cache files.
Security: Need to ensure HTTPS and protect against basic web vulnerabilities.

content.title: 2. The Solution (Automation)
content.description: Instead of manual setup, I built a set of Bash Scripts (Infrastructure as Code - Lite) to automate the entire Provisioning and Deployment process:

content.title: 2.1. Automated Provisioning
content.description: The setup-server.sh script automatically installs and configures standard LAMP Stack (Apache, PHP 8.1, MySQL) in a single run, ensuring consistent environment (Consistency).

content.title: 2.2. Security Automation
content.description: Integrated script for automatic SSL installation via Certbot (Let's Encrypt), automatically handling common Redirect Loop errors between Cloudflare/ALB and Apache.

content.title: 2.3. Database Management
content.description: The setup-database.sh script automatically creates User, Database and imports initial data, eliminating risks of incorrect operations on Production.

content.title: 3.1.1. VirtualHost Optimization
list: Enabled deflate module (Gzip compression) and configured ExpiresByType to cache static resources (Images, CSS, JS) in user's browser for 1 month, significantly reducing server load.

content.title: 3.1.2. Security Headers
list: Directly injected security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, X-Content-Type-Options) into Apache configuration to protect against XSS and Clickjacking attacks.

content.title: 3.2. Linux Permission Management
content.description: Built strict permission mechanism: Code owned by ubuntu, but Apache (www-data) is only allowed to write to necessary directories (upload, caches). This prevents hackers from taking control of the server if web source code has vulnerabilities.

content.title: 3.3. Operational Scripts
content.description: Wrote update-code.sh script to standardize the git pull -> fix permission process. Developers only need to run 1 command for new code to go live safely, without worrying about website crashes due to wrong permissions.

content.title: 4. Results
list: ⏱ Time Savings: Reduced new server setup time from 3 hours to < 10 minutes.
🔒 Security: Achieved A+ SSL score on SSL Labs thanks to standard Hardening configuration.
💰 Cost: System runs smoothly on AWS EC2 t3.medium (~$30/month), handling stable load for thousands of students accessing.
